lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I wonder...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: what will happen if a human is killed by a Nikke here.
Is this some kind of warning?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: No need to be scared.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What makes you say that?
Well, there's only one human at this Outpost, and you're talking to 'em.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: True...

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It makes sense for you to think like that,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but you don't have to worry.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: No need to jump to conclusions.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Anyway, what'd happen to the Nikke IF something like this were to occur?
She'd be declared an Irregular and scrapped.
Enikk would have her put on trial.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: So it's no different than if it happened in the Ark.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What a letdown.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: The courtrooms in each Outpost

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: operate independently of the Ark.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I thought things would be more interesting here.
Once death is involved, whether something is interesting or not should be the last thing on one's mind.
Sorry to disappoint you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Yeah yeah,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'll just agree to disagree for now.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Apology accepted.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Hopefully, I can get a

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: more pleasing answer next time.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What about a Nikke killing another Nikke?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Would that go down as it does in the Ark?
It's largely a judgment call from the Commander.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: So you finally acknowledged the power you hold over us.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: After all, crimes involving human victims and crimes merely involving one's property

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: can hardly be measured by the same standard.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Well, at least I finally heard something of interest.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I can make good use of it.
Use?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Just talking to myself.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You're the only Commander who

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: has ever taken my questions seriously.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I think we'll get along just fine.
What do you mean by "use"?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Despite their differences, black and white

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: are the most closely interlinked colors.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Hence, it's only natural that we'd share some similarities.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Catch you later.
Answer my question.
Crow hasn't replied since then...
